watch.name: National CAS
watch.why: Reported live on 18 November 2026. Up to 3,000 units, in self-contained homes and shared HMOs, across 12 regions in England and Wales. The call-off structure is not yet known. Mack Living intends to bid in all regions. A Find a Tender or Contracts Finder notice for this 3,000 unit requirement was not found.

watch.name: Glasgow private rented sector accommodation
watch.why: Public Contracts Scotland notice OCT567071, published 21 October 2026. Each contract is 250 homes by the end of year one, and the council may award up to four contracts. A proportion of homes must be accessible. The reported start is April 2027, the reported award is around early March 2027, and the reported accessible share is 5%. Those three points are not stated on the notice page.

demand.name: Clearsprings
demand.signal: Asylum accommodation. South of England demand.
demand.public: The Home Office answer of 30 April 2025 places Clearsprings Ready Homes in Wales, the South East and London. On 9 June 2026 Clearsprings told the Home Affairs Committee that about 2,500 bedspaces across the south were proposed and ready to go live.
demand.gap: A separate south of England requirements notice is not yet recorded.

demand.name: Serco
demand.public: The Home Office answer of 30 April 2025 places Serco on the asylum accommodation contracts for the North West, the Midlands and the East of England.
demand.gap: A public notice that requirements have opened nationally is not yet recorded.
